data.summary_en: VisualEvolve's Select--Execute--Evolve--Evaluate evolves executable visual operations and tool-use policies, improving VLM visual tool use; Snapshot Selection and PEA limit regression and evidence overload. Six-set, three-benchmark, four-VLM-backbone evaluation, it beats Initial Skill Library in 23/24 settings; Qwen3.5-Plus gains up to 15.1 percentage points on VisualProbe Hard.
